n = int(n_b_input[0])
b = int(n_b_input[1])
arr_input = input().split()
arr = list(map(int, arr_input))
val = [(-1 if x % 2 == 0 else 1) for x in arr]

sum_val = 0
cost = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    sum_val += val[i]
    if sum_val == 0:
        diff = abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i])
        cost.append(diff)

cost.sort()

totalCost = 0
maxPoints = 0
for c in cost:
    if totalCost + c <= b:
        totalCost += c
        maxPoints += 1

print(maxPoints)
